enchantments.tooltip: Linguistics: This item reduced the cooldowns of your Social skills (Diplomacy, Bluff, Intimidate) by 15%. This does not stack with the Negotiator ability.
Winged Allure: The butterflies of this crown have a tendancy to distract your enemies. When hit or missed in melee combat, your foes have a chance to be Fascinated with no save.
Notable Target: Once per minute, when you use Intimidate, you gain a +100% Profane bonus to threat generation with weapon strikes for 20 seconds.
Natural Armor +16: Passive: +16 Natural Armor Bonus to Armor Class.
Mythic Goggle Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
